### Optional Turbo Loras

[h3_silu_temb_grid.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/deAPI-ai/minimax-h3-33b-int8/resolve/main/loras/h3_silu_temb_grid.safetensors)

---
### V11 Notes

- UPDATE NODEPACK TO V1.5.6 AND COMFYUI TO NEWEST VERSION, and requirements.
- Added Refmod Support, create in subgraph.
- Got rid of fantastic builder kept only luisachaotica.
- Fixed layout issues and removed unwanted dependencies.
- Dropped turbo, it was ruining video and audio. default WF settings will get you 4 skips for "9" steps.
- Added my H3 Combo node that does all modes.
- Overall should be better prompt adherence, faster, and less overhead with reduced peak vram.
- Use reference map to know what the LM is calling everything.
- If you don't like no turbo, just use your favorite settings from before. Shift node in Sampler subgraph for people who want to keep using turbo.

---
- Added my turbo lora, functional strength up to 5.0
- Test default settings, they should be good for most prompts.
- Make sure you're on the newest pytorch+cu combo supported, and newest nodepack + comfy.
- Added original audio mode, avoids degradation and vae decode / Allows you to make music videos etc. it's in the reference subgraph.
- Added FSR RCAS sharpening, 0.3 strength looks natural.
